methodology.aggregation: Median of each metric across 3 runs; ranges retained. Runs are sequential, each in a fresh Chrome profile with an empty browser cache. CDN cache is not purged.
methodology.profiles: Lighthouse default simulated mobile and desktop presets; exact settings saved per run.
methodology.http: Five fresh curl processes per endpoint, compressed HTTP responses; connection/TLS setup included. These timings are not browser lab timings.
methodology.fieldData: No CrUX field data or real-user INP was collected. Total blocking time is a lab metric, not INP.
